panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: This is Low Anthem. A hold of
four hundred. Poor, and mostly Tenders.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: We net the fall and seal it up.
Somebody has to.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: The Makers built the cities under
the sea, and the Dragon.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: That was over three thousand
years ago. Jef is the last who
understands their craft.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: The gift. The sea answers us.
I ask it to care. That is intending.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: Your gift? I cannot tell.
Ione will look at you.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: Jef is about nine hundred years old.
He has no gift. He keeps the Dragon.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: He makes the Threaded.
They answer only to him.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: The Dragon. A kilometre of pale
metal, circling the world.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: Most take it for a living creature.
It is a Maker thing.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: Jef's warrior monks. About a hundred.
Alone or in twos and threes.

panels.speaker: person.sefa
lines: Their rule: Keep the water. Own
nothing you cannot carry. Come
when you are called.
